notes.tech_note: Primary sensor looks dead, no signal.
notes.supervisor_comment: Board set to approved temporary reference.

deciding.sensor_fault_cause: Supervisor says the board was set to an approved temporary reference, which explains the offset without a sensor fault, though the technician calls the sensor dead.
deciding.visit_disposition: The temporary reference explains the offset and the backup is reporting, favouring sign-off despite the part-done check and missing post check.
deciding.data_treatment: Offset is known, but there is no post check and the 38 h gap with an uncertain reference makes provisional flagging as defensible as correcting.
deciding.offset_size: Board mean 1.860 minus logger 1.820 is 40 mm, on the level 2/3 boundary; the board readings differ by 20 mm (1.850 vs 1.870).
deciding.residual_defect: No defects section; the note says no signal and the logger gap is 38 h (not reporting, level 4), but the sensor is not confirmed dead and was part-checked (level 3 possible).
